test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Decide which conclusion(s) logically follows from the given statements.

**Statement****:**

No Pigeon is a Panduk.

Some Panduk are sparrows.

All sparrows are birds.

**Conclusion:**

(I) Some sparrows are not pigeons.

(II) Some sparrows are Panduk.

(III) Some birds are Panduk.

options.text: Either conclusion । follows or Conclusion III follows
All conclusions I, II and III follow

solution:
Given Statements:

No Pigeon is a Panduk.

Some Panduk are sparrows.

All sparrows are birds.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd1d1aa0734b30d67c84ef97b075cedcc215d6808b18a5b04aeb4e08890c628a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sparrows are not pigeons - True (Because, Those part of Sparrows which is Panduk will not Pigeon).

II. Some sparrows are Panduk - True (Because, Some Panduk are Sparrows also Some Sparrows are Panduk also).

III. Some birds are Panduk - True (Because, Those part of birds which is Sparrows will Panduk also).

So, All conclusions I, II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
